## LLM021 Transactional method returns a streaming emitter

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm021 |
| Turn it off | `LLM021: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM021` on the command line |

A method that returns an SseEmitter keeps its transaction open until the whole stream finishes — the connection is held for as long as generation takes. A few slow answers can exhaust the pool; it looks like "streaming endpoints get stuck", but the transaction simply never ends. Send from outside the transaction and keep the transaction around the writes only.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM021` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm021 -->

## What it looks like

`@Transactional` on a method returning `SseEmitter` / `ResponseBodyEmitter`.

## How to fix

Drop `@Transactional` and write through a separate transactional service. The transaction commits when the method returns, long before the stream is written.
